{{Top|leg}}
A '''holographic targeting system''' was part of an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]]'s weapons systems. Located in the command cockpit, the holographic targeting system assisted the [[Walker/Legends|walker's]] [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] by giving them a three-hundred and sixty degree view.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
